Title: deployment error in a google / firebase cloud function

 ```

    "ccxt": "^1.17.283",
    "firebase-admin": "^6.0.0",
    "firebase-functions": "^2.0.5",
    "uuid": "^3.3.2"
  },
```

Here's the error:

```
$ firebase serve  --only functions

=== Serving from '/Users/crypro/projects/CrypPro-marketdata/firebase'...

I'm using:

```

I'm guessing there's something different between the _uuid_ npm package and the _ccxt_ one, but I've no idea what.
